title: Research-gap extraction
tests_passed: 812 full CRIBA tests passed; 1 existing deprecation warning
decisions: Extraction is deterministic and stdlib-only: explicit linguistic cues, sentence-level statements, stable provenance to doc_id, case-insensitive topic filter and semantic deduplication.
Gap objects remain HYPOTHESIS and do not promote evidence to FACT.
Resolved language such as 'addresses the open question' is excluded to prevent false-positive gaps.
An accidentally conflicting top-level gaps.py was moved to ../QUARANTINE_CRIBA_P08/gaps.py, reversibly, because gaps is an existing package.
risks: Rule-based English cue coverage does not cover every domain-specific or non-English formulation.
Sentence segmentation is deliberately lightweight and punctuation-based.
rollback: git revert <P08-T01 commit>; restore ../QUARANTINE_CRIBA_P08/gaps.py only if required
limitations: No network sources, LLMs, external dependencies, database writes or production artifacts were used.
